arm_disposition_boundary.reason: 2017-2025 is consumed development evidence and 2026 is sealed-ineligible; this audit may support or falsify the mechanism but cannot accept or promote the arm.

controls.random_control_sampling: For each UTC year, sample without replacement the same number of eligible seven-day entry timestamps as filled primary breakout entries in that year; compare equal-weight gross seven-day log returns. Samples are diagnostic and do not simulate shared capital.

mechanism_card.causal_driver: Persistent directional demand can carry price beyond a prior 20-day high and continue after entry; the 10-day low exit and 4% protective stop terminate exposure when persistence breaks.
mechanism_card.decision_observable: A completed four-hour close strictly above the maximum high of the prior 120 completed same-segment four-hour bars.
mechanism_card.expected_payoff_shape: Many small false-breakout losses and fewer larger continuation gains; positive skew and profit concentration are expected but must remain within frozen limits.
mechanism_card.falsifier: Reject mechanism support if breakout entries do not beat year-count-matched random seven-day entries, if higher causal directional efficiency does not improve net expectancy, or if results depend excessively on a few trades or months.
mechanism_card.favorable_background: Sustained directional repricing with efficient one-way movement and enough continuation to exceed round-trip costs.
mechanism_card.unfavorable_background: Range-bound or rapidly reversing markets where new highs are liquidity sweeps or short-lived shocks rather than persistent repricing.
mechanism_card.why_costs_matter: False breakouts create repeated spread, fee, and slippage losses; persistence must be strong enough that the right tail pays for whipsaws.

mechanism_feature.classification: At each entry, compare efficiency with the lower and upper terciles of the preceding 720 valid four-hour efficiency observations from the same source segment; the current observation is excluded from its cutoffs.
mechanism_feature.formula: absolute log close change over the latest 120 completed four-hour intervals divided by the sum of absolute four-hour log close changes over those intervals
